gloss: before the Buddhist altar; in front of Buddha

definitions.gloss: before the Buddhist altar; in front of Buddha
definitions.explanation: The space in front of a Buddhist altar ({仏壇|ぶつだん}) or image of the Buddha, where offerings are made and prayers are said. Also used in {御仏前|ごぶつぜん}, the label on condolence money offered after the funeral.

examples.japanese: {仏前|ぶつぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供|そな}える→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧。
examples.english: To offer flowers before the Buddhist altar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{仏前|ぶつぜん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
examples.english: Every morning I put my hands together in prayer before the altar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{香典袋|こうでんぶくろ}→香典袋：24487_koudenbukuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{御仏前|ごぶつぜん}→御仏前：29764_gobutsuzen⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持参|じさん}した→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧。
examples.english: I wrote 'go-butsuzen' on the condolence envelope and brought it to the memorial service.

notes:
Refers to the area before the household altar or a Buddha image, the place for offerings and prayer. The polite form ⟦{御仏前|ごぶつぜん}→御仏前：29764_gobutsuzen⟧ labels condolence money given at or after the ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧ memorial, in contrast to ⟦{御霊前|ごれいぜん}→御霊前：24486_goreizen⟧ used before it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仏前|ぶつぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{供|そな}える→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧: to make an offering before the altar
- ⟦{御仏前|ごぶつぜん}→御仏前：29764_gobutsuzen⟧: label for condolence money after the funeral

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仏壇|ぶつだん}→仏壇：07116_butsudan⟧: Buddhist household altar — the altar itself
- ⟦{御霊前|ごれいぜん}→御霊前：24486_goreizen⟧: 'before the spirit' — condolence-money label used before the 49th-day rite
